title: Ko-fi (tips, commissions, shop)
one_liner: Fans tip you, buy custom work or digital items from one simple page.
pay: You set the price. Ko-fi takes 0% on donations, 5% on shop, memberships and commissions on the free plan, 0% on Gold ($12/month); Stripe/PayPal fees apply.
steps: Turn on commissions or add one digital item.
Set a small number of open slots and a clear price.
Post finished work (with permission) and say slots are open.
catch: Payment fees still apply, and custom work takes time, so price your hours honestly.

match.first_step: Set up Ko-fi commissions with 3 open slots and one example.
